skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of real estate development, the steps and content of the real estate development process, and apply it to specific types of real estate development.

Apply basic planning and calculation tools in real estate development projects, have the ability to work in teams, be responsible and professional in work, and have the ability to think systematically and combine knowledge and skills to present, analyze, and share viewpoints related to real estate development.
Analyze and plan the development of one or several specific types of real estate.
Have the ability to work independently, be responsible for group and personal work, and present and defend personal views in the field of real estate development.
Have the ability to present and defend personal views in the field of real estate development.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the workplace and in society.
